name: Kung Fu: The Legend Continues
description: Like his legendary namesake, Kwai Chang Caine is a warrior monk, operating a Shaolin temple in Northern California. After an evil priest, Tan, destroys the temple, Caine and his young son, Peter each believe the other has perished. The two embark on very different paths -- Caine wanders the Earth, while Peter is a cop. When fate brings the two together, they work to overcome their differing philosophies to battle Tan, and then to help the innocent and bring justice to the new Wild West -- 90s urban America.

videos.title: Initiation (1)
videos.overview: Shaolin priest Kwai Chang Caine reunites with his long-lost son, detective Peter Caine.

videos.title: Initiation (2)
videos.overview: Kwai Chang and Peter team up to fight an old enemy of the Caines' who is taking over Chinatown.

videos.title: Shadow Assassin
videos.overview: The Caines help the author of a book about a Shaolin cult when his friends start turning up dead.

videos.title: Sunday at the Hotel with George
videos.overview: Kwai Chang and Peter encounter a gang of thieves during a wedding reception.

videos.title: Sacred Trust
videos.overview: A thug is murdered after threatening a student, and Kwai Chang is charged.

videos.title: Force of Habit
videos.overview: Kwai Chang helps a physically abused wife who happens to be married to Peter's new work partner.

videos.title: Pai Gow
videos.overview: When losers at high-stakes pai gow are murdered, the Caines go under cover.

videos.title: Challenge
videos.overview: Kwai Chang's nemesis, the crime lord Tan, returns to Chinatown.

videos.title: Disciple
videos.overview: Kwai Chang's student is involved with an illegal fight ring

videos.title: Rain's Only Friend
videos.overview: Peter questions his vocation after he accidentally shoots a bystander.

videos.title: Secret Place
videos.overview: A maniac holds a busload of high-schoolers hostage.

videos.title: Dragon's Eye
videos.overview: A survivalist kills any encroachers, barring the Caines from a rare medicinal plant.

videos.title: Blind Eye
videos.overview: Capt. Blaisdell's blind wife is brutally beaten; later her attacker stalks her again.

videos.title: The Lacquered Box
videos.overview: Shaolin teachings clash with police methods when Kwai Chang and Peter disagree over a criminal.

videos.title: Illusion
videos.overview: Kwai Chang helps Peter catch a heroin smuggler who is importing the drug from the Far East.

videos.title: Straitjacket
videos.overview: Kwai Chang enters a psychiatric hospital to protect a woman targeted for murder.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: The Caines protect a woman who is set to testify against the mob.

videos.title: Dragonswing
videos.overview: Kwai Chang and Peter recruit mercenaries to drive survivalists from a terrorized town.

videos.title: Shaman
videos.overview: An Indian mystic accused of murder enlists Kwai Chang Caine to prove his innocence.

videos.title: I Never Promised You a Rose Garden
videos.overview: Kwai Chang and Peter uncover white slavery in their search for a missing martial arts student.

videos.title: Redemption (1)
videos.overview: The last heir to the Chinese throne needs Kwai Chang Caine's protection.

videos.title: Redemption (2)
videos.overview: The last heir to the Chinese throne needs Kwai Chang Caine's protection.

videos.title: Return of the Shadow Assassin
videos.overview: Alone, Peter must face the Shadow Assassin, who can kill with his thoughts.

videos.title: May I Ride with You
videos.overview: Caine asks Peter if he can spend the day with him, wanting to see how Peter spends a normal day.   Guest Stars- Natalie Radford, Henry Czerny, and Dominic Zamprogna.   Special Guest Star- Regis Philbin

videos.title: Dragon's Daughter
videos.overview: Tan's daughter has returned to Chinatown and is stalking young men in order to flush out her father's killer, Kwai Chang Caine.  It is up to Peter and Caine to stop her.   Guest Stars-Marla Suchantza, Jonathan Whittakar, and Sam Malkin.

videos.title: An Ancient Lottery
videos.overview: The Ancient wins the lottery with a ticket given to him as a goodwill gesture by a greedy developer and upcoming politician.  Now Tan wants it.   Guest Stars-Chuck Shamata, Joel Wyner, Amanda Tapping, and James Spiddel.

videos.title: Laurie's Friend
videos.overview: Peter enlists the help of a young girl, who is psychic, to help find a gun that has been used in the murder of a cop.  Caine discovers the girl has a psychic protector --- another Caine!   Guest Stars-James Purcell, Heather Brown, and Linda Thomson.

videos.title: Temple
videos.overview: Caine and Peter return to Braniff, wherein lies the temple were Peter grew up.  They meet the widow of one of the priests from the temple.  She needs their help since some very familiar townspeople are harrassing her and her son.   Guest Stars-Kerrie Keane, Christopher Redman, Kevin Jubenville, Colin Fox, and Robert Collins.

videos.title: Only the Strong Survive
videos.overview: Peter goes undercover in a Kung Fu tournament to help save a little girl who has been kidnapped.   Guest Stars-Bo Svenson, Alex Carter, and Christine Reeves.

videos.title: Out of the Woods
videos.overview: Peter takes a few days off work, and he and his father go camping.  They come across a group of lost campers and an escaped criminal and his sons.

videos.title: Tournament
videos.overview: An industrialist, who holds a grudge against Caine, sponsors a martial arts tournament.  When Caine enters the tournament, Peter follows him, on a special undercover assignment.

videos.title: The Bardo
videos.overview: Peter is wounded in the line of duty, but he cannot be operated on, because his  life signs are fluctuating.  Caine finds out that Peter's soul is being held in the Bardo, an in-between realm of memories, including those of Caine abandoning Peter.

videos.title: The Possessed
videos.overview: The Church is trying to exorcise a man who is possessed. However, something goes wrong and the demon possesses other people, instead. Somehow, Caine gets involved and tries to help a troubled man who has been possessed.

videos.title: Warlord
videos.overview: To save his father who is  dying, a Chinese warlord  insists that Caine use his healing skills to cure the warlord's father.

videos.title: The Innocent
videos.overview: Caine is one of the jurors in a murder trial.  He is the only juror who believes that the defendent is innocent.

videos.title: Magic Trick
videos.overview: A magician  at a nightclub uses magic to hypnotize and kill wealthy victims.  Caine  pretends to be a magician so that he can stop the killer.

videos.title: Aspects of the Soul
videos.overview: Caine is contacted by Clarence Choi, who seeks friendship and forgiveness for his past attacks against Caine.

videos.title: Kundela
videos.overview: Aborigines are angry about a land deal made by a businessman who happens to be the uncle of Peter's girlfriend.  Pretty soon, aboriginal assassins appear on the scene.

videos.title: The Gang of Three
videos.overview: A group of two elderly men and a Chinese boy, recently back from college, decide to fight crime. When they get themselves involved in  a major robbery by notorious gang, Peter and Kwai Chang Caine must help them.

videos.title: Sunday at the Museum with George
videos.overview: George, an expert thief, returns to steal ancient Chinese treasures, which unleashes a deadly curse.

videos.title: Dragonswing II
videos.overview: The Dalai Lama and  Caine are kidnapped.  Will Peter be able to rescue them, with the help of two former acquaintances, who are mercenaries.

videos.title: Sing Wah
videos.overview: A ruthless black magic cult, that uses an usual form of kung fu,  tries to kill an archeologist because of a document he has deciphered.

videos.title: Enter the Tiger
videos.overview: Peter and Caine come to the rescue of  an impassioned Chinese dissident who is trying to help the democracy movement in his country.

videos.title: Retribution
videos.overview: When a  senator is killed at a Captain Blaisdell's reunion of his former commando team,  Peter says he saw the captain kill the senator.  Caine helps the captain find answers  to this puzzle from an event that occurred in Blaisdell's past.

videos.title: Rite of Passage
videos.overview: Peter gets off on the wrong foot with his new captain. Meanwhile, Caine has travelled to Shambhala to battle an evil warrior who has ties to Peter's world.

videos.title: Plague
videos.overview: When a deadly plague is released by a madman, can Caine come up with the antidote in time?

videos.title: May I Walk With You
videos.overview: When Peter spends a day following Caine on his rounds, they end up dealing with a hostage crisis.

videos.title: The Return of Sing Ling
videos.overview: When a young Chinese emperor is targeted for murder, Peter and Caine end up protecting him during his return trip to China. They are pursued by a determined agent of the Chinese government.

videos.title: Manhunt
videos.overview: When an Assistant District Attorney is murdered, the evidence points to Peter, as the likely suspect.

videos.title: Gunfighters
videos.overview: In this time-travel episode, Caine switches places with his grandfather, the Kwai Chang Caine from the Kung Fu series, endangering his very existence.

videos.title: A Chinatown Murder Mystery: The Case of the Poison Hand
videos.overview: Peter investigates a case where two physicians have died of unknown causes. A third physician says he is also dying and Caine agrees with that diagnosis. The third doctor tell Peter that he knows who has "murdered" him.

videos.title: Target
videos.overview: A South American witch doctor (a "brujo") from Peter's childhood, possesses him.

videos.title: Citizen Caine
videos.overview: Caine runs for City Council to stop a developer frm evicting tenants. Meanwhile, Peter takes the lieutenant's test: a passing grade would mean a transfer.

videos.title: Quake!
videos.overview: An earthquake shakes up the city, and shakes loose a criminal that Peter and Jody just apprehended.

videos.title: Goodbye Mr. Caine
videos.overview: Peter and his father visit a local high school to help the students and teachers after a undercover cop is stabbed at a basketball game.   Guest Stars-Scott Speedman.

videos.title: The Sacred Chalice of I-Ching
videos.overview: Someone's after a diary owned by Caine's father, which contains half a map leading to an ancient chalice with powers ""too great for mortal man.""

videos.title: Eye Witness
videos.overview: Peter must protect a mob lawyer whose past includes a run-in with Caine that ended in tragedy.

videos.title: Demons
videos.overview: Kermit's sister is being dogged by ""dark forces"" in her house, where a murder had been committed. Who's she gonna call? Caine.

videos.title: Deadly Fashion
videos.overview: Rivals of the Shaolin, a terrorist group known as the Scorpion Sect, have infiltrated a fashion show which is on tour. While Caine impersonates a fashionista named Gaston, Peter finds himself in a bodyguard role for the show's supermodel, Alana.

videos.title: Cruise Missiles
videos.overview: Memebers of the 101st Precinct board a cruise ship for a wedding/ Also aboard: terrorists with a cruise missile.

videos.title: The Promise
videos.overview: Caine comes to the aid of on old flame whose physician-husband is being ""run out"" of the town where they live.

videos.title: Flying Fists of Fury
videos.overview: On the set of a martial arts movie, whose star resembles Peter as closely as any identical twin, something evil is sabotaging the film.

videos.title: Banker's Hours
videos.overview: When some high-tech criminals decide to rob a bank, they take more than twenty people hostage. Unfortunately for them, one of the hostages happens to be Caine.

videos.title: Kung Fu Blues
videos.overview: Caine's bluesman friend is singing the blues when his daughter, an up-and-coming singer, gets mixed up with a nasty producer.

videos.title: Brotherhood of the Bell
videos.overview: Caine is held captive in a castle where an ""evil beyond comprehension"" lurks. Its personification: his brother Damon.

videos.title: Destiny
videos.overview: Peter decides to become a Shaolin priest, but a ""negative force"" lurks in the temple where he's studying under Caine.

videos.title: Dark Vision
videos.overview: Peter is having psychic visions about murders.

videos.title: The First Temple
videos.overview: In this episode, Peter and Caine travel to ancient China to help the first shaolin monks fight the warlords.  The monks don't have the tattoos and Peter and Caine must explain the essence of being Shaolin.

videos.title: Circle Of Light
videos.overview: A hold-up man shoots Skalany in a small-town diner, but the real bad guy is his boss---a U.S. Marshall.

videos.title: Prism
videos.overview: Caine has a vision in volving Capt. Simms, gunfire and an underworld figure. Then, witnesses see Simms shoot the mobster.

videos.title: Black Widow
videos.overview: ""Deadly and venomous creatures"" want to use Caine to take over Chinatown. Meanwhile, Peter has a new girlfriend.

videos.title: Shaolin Shot
videos.overview: Somebody's targeting a hockey team, so Peter poses as a player and joins the team.

videos.title: The Phoenix
videos.overview: When the Dalai Lama visits Chinatown, he is targeted by a strange contract killer with flames in his eyes. Peter and Caine find out that the assassin is an old friend.

videos.title: Special Forces
videos.overview: A mercenary named Macklin with whom Caine and Peter have had a run-ins in the past, turns up at a military academy, where cadets are killing themselves.

videos.title: Dragon's Lair
videos.overview: Kids exploring an abandoned house find a trove of Chinese artifacts, including a board game which emits a ""great force"" that hits Caine miles away.

videos.title: Veil of Tears
videos.overview: Kwai Chang Caine enrolls in a speech class while Peter tries to solve a rash of crimes against local merchants.  Several of the merchants,who happen to be in the class, are being terrorized by members of a triad group led by Li Sung (see earlier episode ""Tournament"") and his new disciple Clarence Choi (see earlier episodes ""The Lacquered Box"" and ""Aspects of the Soul"").  Li Sung wants to take control of the successful businesses owned by these merchants, and kidnaps their teacher in an attempt to get them to comply.  Banding together with Caine and Peter, the merchants fight back against the triad and manage to free their teacher and send Clarence and Li Sung back to prison.

videos.title: Chill Ride
videos.overview: A carnival house of horrors scares a man to death --- thanks to its operator, an old adversary of Caine's known as Dr. Frieze.

videos.title: Escape
videos.overview: Caine and Peter trace the missing Kermit to a compound where a terrorist is holding relatives of diplomats and politicians hostage.

videos.title: Who Is Kwai Chang Caine?
videos.overview: After a date with Scalany, Caine is hit by a car, then disappears. Months later he surfaces aa a casino pianist---who recognizes no one from the precinct.

videos.title: Storm Warning
videos.overview: Kermit travels to Florida to seek revenge on the gangster who murdered his brother.

videos.title: A Shaolin Treasure
videos.overview: Sing Wah memebers steal a Shaolin treasure and sell it to a publishing house, which uses it for a promotional treasure hunt. Then Sing Wah decides it wants it back.

videos.title: Dark Side of the Chi
videos.overview: Caine is poisoned by some assailants with a toxin that affects his chi, his life force. According to the Ancient, Caine will die, unless his spirit and his chi can be reunited.

videos.title: Ancient Love
videos.overview: Gangsters from Chinatown seek a key and bracelet that are in the possession of a female kung fu teacher, whose mortally ill grandfather was an old adversary of the Ancient.

videos.title: Blackout
videos.overview: Thieves cause a blackout, allowing the escape of a pair of prisoners at the 101st Precinct .

videos.title: Time Prisoners
videos.overview: When Captain Simms is abducted, she is taken back to 1977.

videos.title: Requiem
videos.overview: Peter has a difficult time protecting a woman from a stalker, a rogue police officer. Meanwhile, Caine is dealing with his own demons.

videos.title: A Shaolin Christmas
videos.overview: A blizzard, on Christmas Eve, provides opportunities to a variety of criminals: a mugger disguised as Santa Claus, a repeat rapist, and an attempted prison break. The officers of the 101st Precinct must deal with them all.

videos.title: May I Talk with You
videos.overview: When a hostage taker demands to be patched into a talk-radio host's show, Caine defuses the crisis on the air --- which launches his own radio career.
